nodes.label: Go plus Web Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: go test ./... (14 pkgs) plus pnpm test/build plus live daemon e2e must stay green.

nodes.label: Markdown + Graphify RAG Engine
nodes.rationale: Plain Markdown with YAML frontmatter and wikilinks indexed by graphify across memory, workspace AST, and Harness2 library.

nodes.label: Harness2 Propose-Probe-Compose Engine
nodes.rationale: Optimizes 8 mutable harness components on refs/lumina/harness in git worktree sandboxes and promotes lessons into a graphify library.

nodes.label: Lumina-Compatible JS/TS Plugin Host
nodes.rationale: On-demand Node v22 worker supporting factory and v2 setup(ctx) plugins across chat.message, tool.execute.before/after, shell.env, permission.ask, and event hooks.

nodes.label: Session Continue, Fork & Shadow-Git Undo
nodes.rationale: Supports -c/--continue per workspace, -s <id>, /fork, lumina run, sanitized export, shadow-Git /undo+/redo, per-session TMPDIR, and model-persist.

nodes.label: Singleflight Standing-Ops KB Sweeper
nodes.rationale: In-daemon idle/close distiller replacing race-prone shell hooks and enforcing canonical manifest stamping.

nodes.label: Lumina plan.md Implementation (M0-M6)
nodes.rationale: Full M0-M6 plan delivery: daemon, fence/broker, router, sessions, plugins, kb, Harness2, TUI, SPA, MCP.

nodes.label: No-Google & Secret Indirection Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Hard-blocks Google APIs/SDKs/fonts/backends and enforces api_key_env/api_key_cmd with non-bypassable credential-file hard-deny.

nodes.label: lumina Live Wiring
nodes.rationale: Responses-transport adapter plus 8-round tool loop, live-verified for reply, file edits, bash.

nodes.label: Responses-Only Transport plus Session Header
nodes.rationale: chat/completions fails for muse models; x-lumina-session header required else MissingSessionID 400.

nodes.label: Lumina Pure-Go Daemon
nodes.rationale: Single CGO_ENABLED=0 Go 1.22+ binary powering Web SPA, Bubble Tea TUI, and lumina run over OpenAPI/SSE/WS.

nodes.label: 4-Mode Permission & Bypass Broker (Shift+Tab)
nodes.rationale: Supports ask, auto-edit, auto-approve (-y), and bypass (--bypass) plus glob rules while preserving immutable secret/no-Google hard denies.

nodes.label: Plan & Build Primary Agent Modes (Tab)
nodes.rationale: Separates structural capability (Tab: plan read-only code fence + scoped plan.md writes vs build full execution) from approval mode (Shift+Tab), with 1-click Plan->Build handoff.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md & Markdown Extensions Loader
nodes.rationale: Merges global and repo AGENTS.md, instructions/*.md, lazy skills/SKILL.md, agents/*.md, and commands/*.md.

nodes.label: Steer Queue Inbox While Working
nodes.rationale: Steer joins at round boundary, Queue chains after completion; one in-flight turn per session.

nodes.label: TUI Thinking Toggle plus Web Tool Pills
nodes.norm_label: tui thinking toggle plus web tool pills
nodes.rationale: Thinking hidden by default, grouped tool steps, footer with model/timing; web pills persist via transcript refetch.

nodes.label: Turn Delta Tool Completed Streaming Events
nodes.norm_label: turn delta tool completed streaming events
nodes.rationale: OnDelta/OnToolStart/OnToolDone/OnTurnEnd drive SSE turn.delta/turn.tool/turn.completed; run has no --verbose flag.

nodes.label: BTC E2E Web Subagent Background Verification
nodes.norm_label: btc e2e web subagent background verification
nodes.rationale: Gathered web price + subagent cross-check + background monitor; websearch falls back to webfetch with no provider keys.

nodes.label: SSE Fragment Accumulation Fix
nodes.rationale: openai_compat accumulated Copilot fragments by index and flushed on finish_reason; regression test fragment_test.go.

nodes.label: Reference system-prompt Parity via toolGuidance
nodes.rationale: Short base + generated per-tool lines adapted into agent.go toolGuidance and wired into RunPrompt and child systems.

nodes.label: Plan-Fence Deny plus Permission Gating
nodes.rationale: subagent denied in plan, ask-gated in build; webfetch/websearch/task_output are read tools under Google hard-deny.

nodes.label: Depth-1 Subagent Runner with Explore Envelope
nodes.norm_label: depth-1 subagent runner with explore envelope
nodes.rationale: Child inherits workspace/model/permission, explore is read-only, depth guard blocks nested subagent.

nodes.label: Subagent Background Web Tool Surface
nodes.rationale: subagent/background + bash background + task_output poll + webfetch + multi-provider websearch with cooldowns.

nodes.label: Long-Session Hardening Pass
nodes.rationale: Single-flight prompts, terminal SSE delivery, permission modal, context gauge, and TUI space-key fixes verified by test-plan TP-04.7/08.7/08.8/09.5/10.4; see also verbose-streaming and subagents-websearch notes.

nodes.label: Per-Session Prompt Single-Flight
nodes.rationale: Steer/queue while a turn runs; max one in-flight Exec; SQLITE_BUSY avoided with single-connection pool + busy_timeout=5000 + bounded write retry.

nodes.label: Terminal SSE plus Auto-Reconnect
nodes.rationale: turn.completed/failed never shed; web and CLI SSE clients backoff-reconnect; working clears on terminal event.

nodes.label: Web Permission Modal Answers permission.asked
nodes.rationale: Modal resolves allow_once/session/deny with no CLI attached and the turn completes.

nodes.label: Live Context Gauge (turn.context)
nodes.rationale: turn.context carries context_tokens/max_tokens (~chars/4 vs provider-advertised window, used-only when unknown) in TopBar, working panel, TUI header, turn footers; RunPrompt compacts newest-first to 80% of window and pre-flights over-window turns.

nodes.label: TUI Space Key Types
nodes.rationale: Typing space inserts a literal space instead of triggering completion or navigation.

nodes.label: Provider-Sourced Context Window
nodes.rationale: ModelMeta.context_window parsed from gateway /models, Ollama /api/show, Copilot /models; never hardcoded.

nodes.label: Router Context Cache with Caps
nodes.rationale: Router.ContextWindow caches per-provider with 15s caps; unknown renders as used-only gauge; mocks split /models from chat.

nodes.label: Conditional Tool Guidance Rendering
nodes.rationale: renderToolGuidance emits Harness/Basic/Lumina lines only for model-visible tools, mirroring opencode render(); explore children stay lean.

nodes.label: Env Block plus Tool Schema Parity
nodes.norm_label: env block plus tool schema parity
nodes.rationale: envBlock date/workspace/git/GOOS plus bash.workdir, grep/glob, subagent.model, question/todowrite specs close opencode audit gaps.

nodes.label: Plan Fence plus Question Allowance
nodes.rationale: Plan mode allows question, denies todowrite as edit-class; plan bash stays read-only even under bypass (deliberate divergence).

nodes.label: Question Round-Trip UI Wiring
nodes.rationale: Model question becomes daemon question.asked SSE, answered via TUI card or web modal POST /api/v1/questions, merged as q=a reply; headless run degrades to best-guess guidance, never hangs.

nodes.label: Patch Tool Envelope
nodes.rationale: internal/tools/patch.go implements opencode Begin Patch envelope (Add/Update/Delete, Move to, @@ hunks) with 4-level seek fallback, edit-class permissions and plan-scoped per-file enforcement.

nodes.label: Config Defaults Seed Flags
nodes.rationale: configBaseFlags() seeds TUI and headless run flags from [defaults] agent/permission_mode (LUMINA_CONFIG aware); CLI flags still win; missing config falls back to build/ask.

nodes.label: Dual Routing Session Headers
nodes.rationale: Every gateway request mirrors x-lumina-session as x-opencode-session; opencode zen 400s (MissingSessionID) without it; covered by TestRoutingSessionHeaders.

nodes.label: agent-browser Skill Port
nodes.rationale: Ported agent-browser skill into .lumina/skills with references and templates; live-verified via lumina run weather lookup.

nodes.label: Skill Advertisement Gap
nodes.rationale: bundle.Skills names+descriptions not in system prompt despite plan.md 6.1; explicit Load-skill prompt required.

nodes.label: Skill Advertisement Fix (skillsBlock)
nodes.rationale: bundle.Skills now advertised in system prompt per plan.md 6.1: skillsBlock (name + description) in RunPrompt + subagent systems, withSkillList annotates the skill tool description. Live-verified: lumina run list your skill names returns agent-browser.

nodes.label: Global Skill Promotion plus Keyless Fallback
nodes.norm_label: global skill promotion plus keyless fallback
nodes.rationale: agent-browser promoted to global ~/.config/lumina/skills via import_global_skills so all workspaces use it; websearch with no provider keys auto-falls back to webfetch Open-Meteo (keyless) for weather, and the no-provider error suggests the webfetch fallback inline.

nodes.label: Session Vault plus Placeholder Remap
nodes.rationale: user-side transparency with opaque per-session placeholder refs; turns encrypted at rest.

nodes.label: Vault Detector Shape Families
nodes.rationale: labeled secrets plus bare sk/AKIA/PEM/digit/segmented/bearer shapes; letters-only refs never collide with numeric codes.

nodes.label: Layer-0 Placeholder Guidance
nodes.rationale: system prompt teaches placeholder refs instead of raw secrets; wider detectors back it.

nodes.label: Widened Credential Hard-Deny
nodes.rationale: whole-tree ssh/aws/gnupg/kube plus shadow files; deny wins over every whitelist in all modes.

nodes.label: Layer-0 External Path Whitelist
nodes.rationale: home/temp/system reads allowed; writes stay workspace plus temp; credential deny still wins.

nodes.label: Session State Resync Endpoint
nodes.rationale: GET /api/v1/sessions/{id}/state returns session + running + pending permission/question for reload/reconnect.

nodes.label: TUI Resync Timeline Rebuild
nodes.rationale: RequestResyncMsg/resyncCmd/applyResync rebuild the TUI timeline from authoritative daemon state; Init loads history on -c/-s attach.

nodes.label: Missed-Started Recovery
nodes.rationale: A progress row or delta for an apparently-idle session rebuilds live state after a missed turn.started.

nodes.label: Effort Variant Picker
nodes.rationale: TUI /variant picker over EffortVariants with NormalizeEffort/ValidEffort/EffortLabel and Anthropic EffortBudget.

nodes.label: Identical-Round Loop Guard
nodes.rationale: Three identical tool rounds in a row trigger a change-approach nudge; task_output polling is exempt; softCap 8 / hardCap 40.

nodes.label: Per-Call Repeat Ledger
nodes.rationale: RunPrompt names any identical tool call on its 3rd execution; catches alternating read/todo spam the identical-round guard missed; task_output exempt.

nodes.label: Cross-Daemon Turn Claim
nodes.rationale: sessions.inflight_owner/since with 12min stale takeover; second daemon prompt 409s with holder identity instead of double-driving transcript.

nodes.label: Daemon Restart Required
nodes.rationale: Old daemon binaries lack /state and running flags; restart required to pick up turn-claim fixes.
